selected_problem: Fresh-main reality testing found the npm workspace inference still returned no validation evidence when the root package declared workspaces but no standard root validation script, even if a child workspace declared a failing standard test script.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: Fresh-main reproduction isolated one evidence-rich central acceptance bottleneck. The committed four-mode router's singular-bottleneck gate therefore routes the replay to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT; no forced rotation was used.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt or fabricated numeric DWAC score is claimed. Selection and routing use committed DWAC source-contract replay over fresh canonical main while the provider remains transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.workspace: Root package.json declares workspaces=['packages/*'] and no standard validation scripts; packages/app/package.json declares a failing test script.
pre_fix_reproduction.observed: The exact fresh-main packageValidationCommands contract returned [], so inferred acceptance produced no child validation command and stopped at VALIDATION_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED instead of observing the real failing workspace test.

changes: When the root package already has a standard validation script, existing bounded root + workspaces behavior is preserved unchanged.

When the root has no standard validation script, inference asks npm itself for workspace package scripts with `npm pkg get scripts --workspaces --json`, reusing npm's own workspace resolution instead of reimplementing workspace glob semantics.
The npm metadata probe receives the same minimal validation environment used by autonomous acceptance so parent secrets are not inherited into the discovery subprocess.

Only standard validation categories actually present in child workspaces become inferred commands; an empty workspace still yields no validation evidence rather than converting no-op --if-present commands into a false PASS.
Focused regressions prove a child-only failing test is executed and that a workspace with no standard validation scripts remains fail-closed.

validation.pre_fix_observation: Fresh-main contract reproduction returned commands=[] for the child-only failing-test fixture.
validation.validation_note: Focused local validation used the exact candidate acceptance source with a compatible one-shot runCommand harness. Real npm workspace metadata discovery and real npm workspace test execution were exercised.

truth_boundaries: This closes the concrete child-only npm-workspace validation gap; it does not claim exhaustive monorepo validation discovery for pnpm, Yarn, nested Python projects or arbitrary build graphs.
Workspace metadata discovery depends on a functioning npm executable; discovery failure remains fail-closed as no inferred validation evidence.
The current validation execution budget remains eight commands.
OS-level filesystem/network sandboxing, Windows descendant-tree equivalence, arbitrary complex semantic synthesis and crash-level filesystem atomicity remain unresolved.
No GitHub Actions are intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push is used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action is performed.
